videos.title: AI Interfaces Of The Future | Design Review
videos.why: The designer behind Cron (now Notion Calendar) critiques real AI products, from agents and adaptive interfaces to voice, showing what works and what does not.

videos.title: Humanizing AI Does Not Help Your Users
videos.why: Why giving an AI a human persona is a quick trick that stops people getting the most out of it.

podcasts.episode: Vitaly Friedman - Beyond Chat:  What's Next for AI Design Patterns
podcasts.why: The founder of Smashing Magazine on how AI is changing the way people use products and which interface patterns are emerging beyond the chat box.

podcasts.episode: #141 Designing Perplexity - The Builder's Guide to AI Design w/Henry Modisett
podcasts.why: Henry Modisett on his time designing Perplexity, making design decisions for a product that did not exist before and keeps changing shape.

reads.title: The Shape of AI
reads.why: A browsable library of AI interface patterns, grouped into wayfinders, inputs, tuners, governors, trust builders and identifiers, each with a short definition.

reads.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
reads.why: Eighteen research-based guidelines grouped by when they apply, from first use and everyday interaction to when the AI is wrong and how it should change over time.

reads.title: People + AI Guidebook
reads.why: Google's guide to deciding whether a feature needs AI at all, then designing for trust, explanations and errors when it does.
